title: Quinqui jargon
extract: Quinqui jargon is associated with quincalleros. They are a semi-nomadic people who live mainly in the northern half of Spain. They prefer to be called mercheros. They have declined in number from earlier reports and are possibly vanishing as a distinct ethnic group.
